title: Dependabot now supports npm 12, pnpm 11 and 12, and Bun 1.4
author: Allison

summary: You can now upgrade your projects to npm 12, pnpm 11 or 12, or Bun 1.4 and keep receiving Dependabot updates. Support for these package manager versions is available to all github.com users and will be included in GitHub Enterprise Server 3.24.
